adoption.note: Failure to pass is insufficient evidence, not proof of no advantage. At 24 layouts the fixed bounds require internal mean >77.7% and Pika difference >50.4 percentage points. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive only; no early enable, no tuning.

repetitions.limitation: Independent public-cycle verification of current supported long-check rules, not complete competition chase/threat adjudication. Forced/optional describes immediate final-ply alternatives only. Recorded observations cannot prove unrecorded process-memory privacy.

limitations: Synthetic sampled layouts only; color pairs are correlated. No population Elo or human-game superiority claim.
Only demonstrated single-side long checking is automated. Long chase/threat/mutual responsibility and change procedures remain incomplete; unresolved is not draw.
400-ply runner cap is unresolved. Core root 400-ply handling still uses its program limit; deep cycles are heuristic cutoffs, not full adjudication.
Equal 2000 ms, at most four search workers and 64 MiB TT, not equal total RSS or equal TT entries. Warm readiness excluded; observation/sampling/IPC/search/reaping included.
Historical mover-loss results are not pooled. No parameter changes, result-based replacement or default activation.
